name: Westcliff University
description:
Do you want to study at a university with a close-knit, 10:1 student-to-faculty ratio?

Westcliff University is renowned for its academic excellence and for incorporating practical experience into its degrees to boost graduate employability.

The university has 3 campus sites across Southern California and also allows full-time students to enroll in online courses.

Westcliff University has very high satisfaction rates for all its courses, including a 92% overall university satisfaction rating for their undergraduate programs, 91% for their masters programs and 91% for their doctoral programs!

Stand-out facts about Westcliff University:

  • 85% of its student body are international students
  • Ranked #1 for top graduate Marketing programs
  • Ranked Top 200 of 1000 for Peace, Justice, Strong Institutions (Times Higher Ed., 2022)

Are you unsure about how to make the transition to become an international student? Do you daydream about studying abroad but want to make that a reality? Perhaps you want to sample living in the USA while actively working towards building a better future? 

Discover why Westcliff University might just be the place for you!

View courses now

About the University

Westcliff University is a private, for-profit university in Irvine, California. Established in 1993, the University specializes in Business and Education. The curriculum is designed with practical learning embedded into the teaching style so students are work-ready upon graduation.

The high-quality campus programs attract students from various backgrounds, as approximately 98 countries are represented in the student body.

Westcliff University offers various first-rate facilities to support international students. The Office of International Services can help with immigration-related actions, such as visa applications and travel documents.

The English Language Learning (ELL) program also offers students the opportunity to improve their language skills. Since the University is dedicated to the academic progress of its students, individual consultations are provided to students for help with writing assignments via the writing center. From the technology center to the entrepreneurship center, the facilities at Westcliff University empower students to achieve their potential.

Student Life

The campus is populated with outgoing and active students who enjoy leisurely sports, participating in community projects, or running one of the many student clubs registered with the student union. Varsity sports are a big part of campus life and a great way to feel a part of a group with fellow students. The University is rated highly by students, and its 92% graduation rate shows this.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Westcliff University offers student housing that comprises fully furnished apartments with kitchenettes, living areas, and shared bedrooms. The University's Office of International Services is available to assist international students in finding suitable accommodation, both on or off-campus, as desired.

The University partners with local apartment complexes if students want to pursue a more independent living arrangement. International students can also choose to live with host families, providing an immersive cultural experience and a chance to improve their English language, if necessary.
